The frozen files must not be edited; this receipt is the correction of record.

The W2 meter does not re-verify the feature-store manifest.json hash (H7B did, to resolve fixture paths); W2 pins the two row-manifest paths as literals and hash-verifies row manifests and weights directly, which is an equivalent guarantee for the fixtures actually used.
